metadata.agent_last_message:
Implemented the Rust (stable, 2021) Cargo project in `output/` with **no external dependencies**.

- Builds/runs with:
  - `cargo build --release --manifest-path output/Cargo.toml`
  - `cargo run --release --manifest-path output/Cargo.toml -- parse --input <path.ics> --output <out.json>`
  - `cargo run --release --manifest-path output/Cargo.toml -- expand --input <path.ics> --from <ISO> --to <ISO> --output <out.json>`
- Core implementation files:
  - `output/src/ics.rs` (RFC 5545 parsing: unfolding, params, TEXT unescape, components + warnings)
  - `output/src/rrule.rs` + `output/src/recur.rs` (RRULE parse + expansion with BYxxx/BYSETPOS/WKST/COUNT/UNTIL)
  - `output/src/timezone.rs` (in-file `VTIMEZONE` offset resolution + fold/nonexistent warnings)
  - `output/src/expand.rs` (`expand` occurrences + RECURRENCE-ID overrides, THISANDFUTURE handling, sorting)
  - `output/src/out.rs` + `output/src/json.rs` (schema-shaped JSON output)
